# Mendi.io

> Mendi is a neurofeedback headset powered by fNIRS technology that trains your prefrontal cortex for better focus, stress reduction, and cognitive performance.

Mendi.io is the official website for Mendi, a wearable neurofeedback device developed by Mendi Innovation AB in Sweden. The platform serves both individual users and professional organizations including NASA and KU Leuven, with a community of over 10,000 users.

## Key Topics

- Mendi Headset
- fNIRS (functional near-infrared spectroscopy)
- Neurofeedback
- Prefrontal cortex (PFC) training
- Brain health
- Focus improvement
- Stress reduction
- Mental wellness
- Neuroscience-validated
- Brain training device
- Wearable technology
- Cognitive performance
- ADHD support
- Mental fitness

## Product & Technology

- [The Mendi Headset](https://www.mendi.io/products/mendi): Main product page detailing Mendi Headset features, fNIRS technology, and purchase options.
- [The Science Behind Mendi](https://www.mendi.io/pages/science): Scientific explanation of fNIRS technology, prefrontal cortex training, and neurofeedback research.
- [Homepage](https://www.mendi.io): Homepage showcasing Mendi neurofeedback headset for focus, stress reduction, and cognitive performance.

## Community & Impact

- [Stories](https://www.mendi.io/pages/stories): User testimonials and customer stories from 10,000+ Mendi community members.
- [For Professionals](https://www.mendi.io/pages/for-professionals): Professional programs showcasing Mendi adoption by NASA, KU Leuven, and enterprise organizations.
- [About Us](https://www.mendi.io/pages/about): Company story, mission, and Mendi's crowdfunding success on Kickstarter and Indiegogo.

## Learning & Support

- [Brain Health Blog](https://www.mendi.io/blogs/brain-health): Blog covering brain health, neurofeedback, cognitive function, and mental wellness topics.
- [FAQ](https://www.mendi.io/pages/faq): Frequently asked questions about Mendi headset, fNIRS technology, and getting started.
